text:
Jia Li: nightly-eval-bot flagged a regression after the v22b weight + tokenizer rollout. 12 promptsets with >5% BLEU/ROUGE drop, but highest failures on legal-summary and csv-table-format.

nightly-eval-bot: ALERT v22b vs v21 baseline: 12 promptsets failed overall thresholds. top diffs: legal-summary (↑hallucination), csv-table-format (↑truncation), name-casing (token boundary shifts).

Samir Patel: can you paste a compact example with the two generations? helps triage.

Jia Li: sure — minimal repro from failing promptset "legal-summary-3":

Prompt:
"Summarize the ruling: The court held that the tax exemption in §12 applies only to nonprofit educational institutions. Include the holding and one line on precedent."

v21 (baseline):
"Holding: The court held that §12's tax exemption applies only to nonprofit educational institutions. Precedent: This follows Smith v. City (1998), which limited exemptions to organizations with independent educational missions."

v22b (after upgrade):
"Summary: The tax exemption applies to taxpayers who filed under subsection (a). The decision reverses prior holdings and imposes a broader test. Precedent: None cited."

Jia Li: differences are substantive — v22b omits the nonprofit qualifier and hallucinates reversal. also more abrupt sentence truncation on long lists.

Maya Chen: any tokenizer changes in the v22b onboarding? casefold, unicode normalization, merges? @Ryan O'Neill

Ryan O'Neill: there was a tokenizer tweak in PR #0a1b2c3 — enabled casefold by default and updated merge rules to prefer lowercased merges. intended to reduce vocab size and stabilize embeddings.

Samir Patel: hmm that aligns with a name-casing promptset failure we saw. can you show tokenizations?

Jia Li: token-level diff for "McDonald's vs MCDONALD" (toy):
```
v21.tokens("McDonald's") -> ["Mc", "Donald's"]
v22b.tokens("McDonald's") -> ["mc", "donald", "s"]
```
v22b splitting into more subtokens and lowercasing -> shifted attention indices.

Maya Chen: lowered merges + casefold could shift KV caching alignment and positional attention for long prompts. did we change any serialization order or seeding?

Ryan O'Neill: no seed changes. runtime/serving kernel same. only tokenizer config and a small quantization PR for int8 fallback in canary (PR #4d5e6f) — the quant path was only enabled on dedicated int8 tests, not hosted.

Jia Li: i reran a quick compare with float16 and int8 quant profiles on the same v22b weights. float16 still fails but less amplified; int8 made hallucination probability higher and increased truncation on table outputs.

Samir Patel: so two likely contributors: tokenizer casefold/merges shift and quantization sensitivity. which one is dominant?

Jia Li: quick ablation:
- v22b + v21 tokenizer (no casefold): failures drop by ~70% on legal-summary, still some csv truncation.
- v22b + casefold but float16: partial regression (~40% failures).
- v22b + casefold + int8: worst.

Jia Li: conclusion — tokenizer casefold/merge change is primary; quantization amplifies.

Maya Chen: action items?

Ryan O'Neill: short-term: rollback tokenizer config on canary, pin casefold False for v22b canary image. long-term: add token-boundary regression tests in onboarding harness and add token-diff step in model rollouts.

Samir Patel: I'll open a checklist ticket: MODEL-ONBOARD-1123. Steps: 1) minimal repro saved in /evals/repro/legal-summary-1749994321.json, 2) pin tokenizer config, 3) run int8/fp16 ablation on canary, 4) notify customers if rollout had wide impact.

infra-bot: Deploy note: PR #0a1b2c3 was deployed to canary at 2025-11-22T03:12:14Z by ryan.o. Rolling back tokenizer config to previous commit 0f9e8d7 is scheduled if triage confirms.

Jia Li: saved sample generations + token diffs to the thread: /shared/triage/1749994321/*. Also uploading the nightly-eval diff chart (AUC drop per promptset).

Samir Patel: thanks. i'll own follow-up and update MODEL-ONBOARD-1123 with timestamps and owners. tagging @Maya Chen for adding tokenization regression tests to the onboarding CI.

Maya Chen: on it. adding a job that runs token-diff for 50 anchor prompts and fails rollout if token shift > threshold.

Jia Li: one more note — some downstream apps relied on token-case sensitivity (legacy prompts). we should add a compatibility flag and announce to partners.

Samir Patel: agreed. communication draft assigned in the ticket.

Jia Li: thanks all. closing initial triage, will post back after rollback experiment.

Ryan O'Neill: ping when rollback is live, i'll run a canary eval pass.

nightly-eval-bot: scheduled rerun for canary at 2025-11-22T04:00:00Z.
